scripts.setup-all: npm run setup && echo "Download Golang dependencies..." && go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest && go get ./...
scripts.upgrade-all: npx npm-check-updates -u && npm run setup && echo "Update Golang dependencies..." && go get -u ./...
scripts.build-all: npm run build-cargo && swag init && npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && CGO_ENABLED=1 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-linkmode 'external' -extldflags '-lstdc++ -lssl -lcrypto' -s -w" -buildvcs=false -mod=readonly -v -o xivi .
scripts.build-all-win: npm run build-cargo && swag init && npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && go build -ldflags "-linkmode 'external' -extldflags '-lstdc++ -lssl -lcrypto' -s -w" -buildvcs=false -mod=readonly -v -o xivi .
scripts.docker-run: open-cli http://localhost:3000 && docker run -p 3000:3000 -v serve:/xivi/serve -v config:/xivi/config --rm xivi
